paraphrase: CCC 36-38: the Catechism teaches, quoting Dei Filius, that the Church holds and teaches that God, the first principle and last end of all things, can be known with certainty from the created world by the natural light of human reason; it adds that in historical conditions man experiences many difficulties in knowing God by reason alone, so that revelation is needed for such truths to be known by all with ease and certainty.
